nphi.title: GHPP Indonesia – vaccine infrastructure and local production
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health and partners (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Supports local production of medicines and vaccines in Indonesia, with training in biotechnology and medicine production.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P81 – Strengthening biosecurity and response capacities in Southeast Asia
nphi.with: UK Health Security Agency; Sustainable Criminal Justice Solutions; Ospedale Luigi Sacco; VERTIC; MORU Tropical Health Network
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national inventories of high-risk biological materials and contributes pandemic surge-capacity tools, including the SCAT e-learning.

nphi.title: RIVM–Indonesia partnership on AMR and One Health
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health and government delegation
nphi.summary: RIVM partnered with Indonesia on antimicrobial resistance and One Health from 2016, also discussing climate, air quality and waste, and hosted an Indonesian ministerial delegation in 2019.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P15 – Laboratory iso-bank system for biosecurity and biosafety
nphi.with: Erasmus University; TNO
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which assessed biorisk management and built a database linking laboratories and hospital information systems in three Southeast Asian countries.

nphi.title: BRIN veterinary science centre – University of Miyazaki CADIC exchange agreement
nphi.actor: National Research and Innovation Agency (BRIN), Research Organization for Health
nphi.with: Center for Animal Disease Control (CADIC), University of Miyazaki
nphi.summary: Academic exchange agreement signed in June 2026 between BRIN's Research Centre for Veterinary Science and Miyazaki's animal infectious disease centre.

nphi.title: BRICS NPHI online meeting hosted by NCDC India (2026)
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: China CDC; NPHIs of BRICS members and partner countries (nearly 30 representatives)
nphi.summary: Under India's 2026 BRICS chairship, NCDC hosted an online meeting of national public health institutes from BRICS members and partner countries, which discussed surveillance and early warning and the operational framework of a BRICS NPHI…

nphi.title: Indonesia–Thailand health cooperation MoU
nphi.with: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand
nphi.summary: Bilateral health MoU signed in Bangkok in the presence of both heads of government, centred on joint capacity for global challenges such as future pandemics, health system resilience and cross-border health issues.

nphi.title: Updated Indonesia–UK health MoU (disease detection, AMR, genomics)
nphi.with: UK Department of Health and Social Care
nphi.summary: Updated bilateral MoU signed during the 78th World Health Assembly, covering disease detection and control including AMR and One Health, genomics and biotechnology, digital health and health workforce training.

nphi.title: KITA SEHAT – Australia–Indonesia Partnership for Health Transformation
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Indonesia; Bappenas
nphi.summary: An eight-year Australia–Indonesia programme supporting primary health care policy and services, with a health security component that strengthens surveillance systems, workforce capacity and cross-sector coordination.

nphi.title: CSIRO/ACDP partnership program under Partnerships for a Healthy Region
nphi.actor: CSIRO Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness (ACDP)
nphi.with: Animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia; Pacific field diagnostic networks
nphi.type: Programme (DFAT Partnerships for a Healthy Region)
nphi.summary: AUD 24.2m CSIRO program (over AUD 12m via ACDP) strengthening animal health laboratories in Southeast Asia, testing at high-risk sites such as wildlife markets and boosting Pacific field diagnostic networks.

nphi.title: Doherty Institute Strategic Partnership for Prevention, Surveillance and Response to Infectious Diseases across the Indo-Pacific
nphi.with: In-country university and laboratory partners (not individually named); Nossal Institute provides GEDSI/WASH expertise
nphi.summary: A four-year DFAT-funded partnership under Partnerships for a Healthy Region that builds workforce, laboratory and genomic surveillance capacity, AMR capacity and data for decision-making in Southeast Asia and the Pacific.

nphi.title: CEPI – Bio Farma rapid-response vaccine manufacturing partnership
nphi.with: Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations (CEPI)
nphi.summary: Ten-year partnership from September 2023 with up to US$15 million in initial CEPI funding for mRNA and viral-vector manufacturing at Bio Farma, with capacity reserved to supply Global South countries in outbreaks.

nphi.title: WHO – China CDC training on intelligent public health and open-source epidemic intelligence (EIOS)
nphi.with: World Health Organization (EIOS); delegates from WHO Western Pacific Region member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: KDCA support to ASEAN infectious disease early warning and risk assessment
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Funds and supports the operation of an ASEAN regional system for infectious disease early warning and risk assessment.

nphi.title: CDC Southeast Asia Regional Office
nphi.with: Host ministries of health; ASEAN
nphi.summary: CDC's SEA regional office in Hanoi (2021) coordinates seven bilateral country offices and ASEAN partnerships on AMR, One Health, border health, lab systems, emergency management and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: ACPHEED – regional ASEAN centre for public health emergencies (Thailand, Indonesia, Viet Nam)
nphi.actor: ASEAN Centre for Public Health Emergencies and Emerging Diseases (ACPHEED), secretariat hosted by Thailand
nphi.with: ASEAN Member States' health ministries; Japan-ASEAN Integration Fund (JAIF); Australian Government
nphi.summary: Regional ASEAN centre announced in November 2020 and set up across three host countries, with the secretariat office in Thailand and further hubs in Indonesia and Viet Nam; Japan committed US$50 million and Australia AU$21 million to…

nphi.title: APCOVE – Asia Pacific Consortium of Veterinary Epidemiology (phases 1 and 2)
nphi.with: Australian and New Zealand veterinary schools; national animal health services
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded consortium set up in 2020 to build veterinary epidemiology capacity for animal and zoonotic disease surveillance in eight Asia-Pacific countries.

nphi.title: ASEAN Emergency Operations Centre Network for public health emergencies
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health Malaysia (lead, ASEAN EOC Network)
nphi.with: Public health emergency operations centres of ASEAN Member States
nphi.summary: Network of national public health EOCs set up by ASEAN Member States around 2017 to coordinate emergency preparedness and response, later led by Malaysia; it held regional meetings and tabletop exercises during COVID-19.

nphi.title: Mitigation of Biological Threats (MBT) in the ASEAN Region Program
nphi.actor: Global Affairs Canada (Weapons Threat Reduction Program)
nphi.with: ASEAN Secretariat; ASEAN EOC Network; ASEAN BioDiaspora Virtual Center; ACPHEED; PHAC (participant)
nphi.summary: A Canadian-funded ASEAN programme, running since 2014, that strengthens regional biosafety, biosecurity, surveillance and preparedness. It helped set up the ASEAN EOC Network and the BioDiaspora Virtual Center. Phase 3 (2024–2027) was…

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)
nphi.actor: Ministry of Public Health, Thailand (Department of Disease Control)
nphi.with: FETP programmes of ASEAN Member States and China, Japan, Korea; ASEAN Secretariat
nphi.summary: Regional network linking field epidemiology training programmes across ASEAN and China, Japan and Korea, set up in Bangkok in 2011 with Thailand's Ministry of Public Health endorsed as focal point.

nphi.title: SEAOHUN – Southeast Asia One Health University Network
nphi.actor: Southeast Asia One Health University Network (SEAOHUN), Chiang Mai University
nphi.with: 67 universities in national One Health university networks; USAID; KOICA; US Department of State
nphi.summary: Regional university network founded in 2011, with its secretariat at Chiang Mai University, that builds the One Health workforce through curricula, exchanges, fellowships and joint projects in Southeast Asia.

nphi.title: IMR as SEAMEO TROPMED Regional Centre for Microbiology, Parasitology and Entomology
nphi.with: SEAMEO TROPMED Network
nphi.summary: IMR has hosted the SEAMEO TROPMED regional centre for microbiology, parasitology and entomology since 1967, running regional diploma courses for Southeast Asian health professionals; it is also a WHO collaborating centre for vector…

nphi.title: CDC Indonesia country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; Ministry of Agriculture; Ministry of Environment and Forestry; Indonesia FETP (MOH with 7 universities)
nphi.summary: CDC has collaborated with the Government of Indonesia for more than 50 years on disease surveillance, laboratory systems, FETP and lab training, vaccine-preventable diseases and influenza.

nphi.title: Symposium on Surveillance-Response Systems Leading to Tropical Disease Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute; WHO; regional NTD/malaria networks
nphi.summary: Recurring international symposium co-organised by NIPD and Swiss TPH on surveillance-response systems for eliminating tropical diseases. The 2026 Shanghai edition also hosted annual meetings of China–Africa and Asian schistosomiasis,…

nphi.title: Indonesia MoH – US HHS health cooperation MoU
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
nphi.summary: Five-year MoU on clinical research, public health and health systems, including emergency preparedness, disease surveillance and control, climate and health, workforce training and digital health, with attention to tuberculosis.

nphi.title: China CDC – GOARN Tier 1.5 and training-of-trainers workshop for Asian responders
nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: EMT TTT – EMT twinning, training and knowledge transfer
nphi.with: MoHSS (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Uganda); Muhammadiyah Disaster Management Center (Indonesia); Johanniter Auslandshilfe; I.S.A.R. Germany; Malteser International; WHO EMT Secretariat; WHO EURO, AFRO, SEARO
nphi.summary: Strengthened national Emergency Medical Teams through twinning and training, with IPC focus in Africa.

nphi.title: ICMR-NIV mpox diagnostic training for South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.with: Health and laboratory staff of nine South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: During the 2022 mpox outbreak, ICMR-NIV Pune trained health workers from nine Asian countries in mpox testing, case definitions, sample collection and lab equipment. It also offered testing kits, reagents and probes on request.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: EMT TT – EMT twinning and training
nphi.with: Emergency Situations Coordination and Urgent Assistance Center (Georgia); Muhammadiyah Disaster Management Center (Indonesia); WHO EMT Secretariat; WHO EURO; WHO SEARO; Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund; I.S.A.R. Germany
nphi.summary: Paired German EMTs with teams in Georgia and Indonesia and trained EMT coordination experts.

nphi.title: JICA project: Strengthening capacity for early warning and response (EWARS) to infectious diseases
nphi.with: JICA
nphi.summary: Four-year technical cooperation improving surveillance in pilot provinces, staff skills and the national laboratory network.

nphi.title: Australia Indonesia Health Security Partnership (AIHSP) – human health component
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health, Indonesia (Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control)
nphi.with: DFAT; Directorate of Vector-Borne and Zoonotic Disease Prevention and Control
nphi.summary: Subsidiary arrangement signed in July 2020 for AU$7.5 million in Australian technical assistance (2020–2025) on One Health coordination, zoonotic preparedness, surveillance, laboratory capacity and epidemiologist training.

nphi.title: CSIRO – Eijkman Institute COVID-19 research partnership
nphi.with: Eijkman Institute for Molecular Biology; UN Pulse Lab Jakarta
nphi.summary: With AUD 1 million in Australian funding, CSIRO joined the Eijkman Institute's vaccine expert advisory panel. CSIRO's Data61 also worked with Pulse Lab Jakarta on predictive analytics for disease hotspots, to strengthen Indonesia's…

nphi.title: ASEAN-Australia Health Security Fellowships (Master of Applied Epidemiology)
nphi.with: ASEAN ministries of health; DFAT
nphi.summary: Fellowship programme agreed after the 2018 ASEAN-Australia Special Summit, in which ASEAN health officials complete ANU's applied epidemiology degree while working in their home institutions and Australian fellows do field placements in…

nphi.title: Taiwan CDC – US CDC regional laboratory diagnosis trainings under the Global Cooperation and Training Framework
nphi.with: US CDC; national laboratories of South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: Series of regional laboratory trainings co-run by Taiwan CDC and US CDC under the GCTF, starting with MERS-CoV diagnostics in 2015 and followed by Zika, dengue/chikungunya and enterovirus courses for laboratory staff from Asia-Pacific…

nphi.title: China–ASEAN Epidemiology Professional Training Programme (CFETP)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; ministries of health of ASEAN member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's field epidemiology training programme ran short field-epidemiology courses in Beijing for ASEAN health staff. The courses were part of the China–ASEAN Public Health Talent Cultivation 100-Person Plan (2014–2017), commissioned…

nphi.title: APEIR – Asia Partnership on Emerging Infectious Diseases Research
nphi.actor: Universitas Indonesia, Faculty of Public Health (APEIR coordinating office)
nphi.with: Researchers, practitioners and senior officials in member countries; Connecting Organizations for Regional Disease Surveillance (CORDS)
nphi.summary: Regional research partnership founded in 2006 linking researchers and government officials in six Asian countries on emerging infectious diseases and their burden on poor and marginalised groups; a member network of CORDS.

nphi.title: Regional Field Epidemiology Training Programme for South-East Asia at NCDC India
nphi.actor: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), India
nphi.with: WHO SEARO
nphi.summary: NCDC, a WHO collaborating centre for epidemiology and training, runs a regional field epidemiology course for health staff from WHO South-East Asia Region countries.

nphi.title: Multidrug-resistant TB and malaria in Indonesia and PNG
nphi.with: Indonesian Ministry of Health; Gadjah Mada University; Burnet Institute; University of Melbourne
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$3 million) on cost-effective treatment of drug-resistant malaria, TB case detection and prevention, and training local researchers.

nphi.title: Antibiotic dispensing by private drug sellers in Indonesia
nphi.with: Gadjah Mada University; Sebelas Maret University; LSHTM; George Institute for Global Health
nphi.summary: DFAT-funded grant (AU$1.91 million) studying how private drug sellers dispense antibiotics and testing interventions to curb self-medication driving AMR.
